message.content: My stools have been dark over the last four days. I can't say for sure whether they're tarry or sticky, and they haven't been pale or clay-coloured. I haven't noticed anything about my urine, so I'm not sure about that. I haven't had any tummy pain. I had my gallbladder taken out in the past, but I don't remember any earlier jaundice or anaemia. Nobody has mentioned a family history of blood disorders, and I don't know of any. The jaundice has just been getting worse over these four days, and I've felt very tired and lightheaded.
